title: Collins Market post review
subtitle: Drafts for the rest of November and December 2026
intro:

posts.title: The Clocktower Building
posts.existingNote: The Clocktower Reel v8 is already produced and is sitting in the Draft Bank for a future Friday. The Story version ran on November 13. This would be the feed Reel, not a repeat of that Story.
posts.caption:
A bowling alley inside the Clocktower Building? Yep.

Built in 1890 as Staunton's first YMCA, this Beverley Street landmark once housed a gym, running track, library, auditorium, and a bowling alley.

A whole lot of community life behind that familiar clock. Next time you're downtown, look up.

Did you know this piece of Staunton history?

Downtown Fact Fridays, presented by Collins Market.

#CollinsMarket #DowntownStaunton #StauntonVA #FactFriday #StauntonHistory
posts.imageNote: Preview still from the Clocktower series. The finished Reel v8 already exists and would be used for this feed post.

posts.title: Born right here
posts.caption:
A future president was born right here in Staunton.

Woodrow Wilson was born on December 28, 1856. His birthplace still stands in town.

Have you walked past it?

Downtown Fact Fridays, presented by Collins Market.

#CollinsMarket #DowntownStaunton #StauntonVA #FactFriday #StauntonHistory
